description: This file provides API functions for authentication-related operations in a React-based web application, including registration, login, and MFA verification.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Handles user registration by sending a POST request to /auth/register with email and password.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Performs initial login validation, possibly involving MFA, by posting email and password.

methods.name: verifyMfa
methods.description: Verifies MFA OTP for a user and sets authentication tokens upon success.
